column1: # Expected corpus-scan status per page for the pdfjs corpus (#862).
#          (no header row: the loader only skips one on line 1, and these
# A RATCHET, not an aspiration — it records what each page does today so a
# regression fails loudly. Several statuses are CORRECT outcomes:
#   PASS_ONE     only one oracle corroborated (they disagree with each other)
#   EXCISE_ONLY  excise rendered and no oracle could — coverage without
#   MALFORMED_PDF / EMPTY_DOC  the fixture is broken or hostile on
#   AGREED_REFUSAL  excise refused AND no oracle rendered it either —
# One status is NOT a correct outcome and must never be pinned bare:
#   EXCISE_SIDE_GAP  excise refused but an oracle rendered the page. An
#                oracle proves it is renderable, so this records an excise
#                bug. File it, then pin the row with the issue number in
#                the note column — or fix it.
#   *            load-dependent when measured (see the note on the row) —
#                asserts only that the page was scanned
# Keys are corpus-relative PATHS, not basenames: this corpus may have
# Baseline: PASS=1257, PASS_ONE=15, MALFORMED_PDF=2, EXCISE_ONLY=2, AGREED_REFUSAL=1, RECOVERED_MALFORMED_CONTENT=1, EMPTY_DOC=1

column5: Reference renderer timeouts make PASS/PASS_ONE load-dependent.
